docs.summary: A storage buffer every shader declaring a buffer of this name reads, a world's over the renderer's. Null removes it. Draws reading it wait for earlier GPU writes to it. To dispose it, set null and dispose it after the next SubmitFrame; one disposed while set drops out at the next SubmitFrame. Host thread.
